args.subject: Update on Your Shipping Issue
args.body:
Dear Customer,

We have reviewed your account and found that the registered shipping site for your contract is Pune DC, not Rotterdam DC‑VZZ1 as mentioned. As a result, the reshipping fee refund cannot be processed under the current terms.

If you believe this is an error or wish to update your shipping site, please let us know and we will be happy to assist.

Best regards,
Support Team
